ground_truth_basis.note: REGRESSION BASELINE, not hand-curated ground truth. This product has 432 bands across 121 platform x algorithm x QA-filter groups with only 4 distinct leaf names, so per-band curation is not meaningful here and role correctness for any single band is not asserted. What this fixture does guarantee is that the classification of a 432-band colliding-leaf inventory does not change silently -- the case that historically produced an ambiguous-refusal blowup.
ground_truth_basis.why_it_is_usable_anyway: The pinned primary_var resolves the science variable directly, so the agent never has to rank these 432 candidates.
